title: Velo Client 1.5: A whole new sky
summary: Custom Skybox with eight hand-made skies, lyrics that hit on the beat, pets that sit, do tricks and join your emotes, drawable heart variants, smooth clips on any PC - plus faster starts and lots of fixes.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.5** changes what you look at every second you play: the sky. On top of that, your lyrics now move with the music, your pet listens to you, and clips record smoothly even on older PCs.

blocks.caption: Eight new skies, each with a preview in the new picker.

items: Replace the sky with **8 built-in skies**: Starry Night, Deep Space, Velo Nebula, Aurora, Crimson Dusk, Sunset Glow, Cotton Candy and Pastel Day
**Choose Skybox...** opens a picker with a **preview of every sky** - or **import your own picture** (a 2:1 panorama or a cube-map cross)
**Sharp stars at any screen size** with a gentle twinkle, and a **Stars** slider
The game's own **sun and moon** rise and set on top of your sky - the moon even shows its **phase**
Terrain, water, clouds, players **and your lyrics stay in front** of the sky
Rotation, slow spin, opacity, brightness and darker at night

blocks.caption: Aurora - one of the new skies.

blocks.text: Lyrics that hit on the beat

items: Velo now **listens to the beat** of what you play (Spotify and anything else) instead of guessing from the words
Pick what happens on the **big moments** - hard hits and drops: **zoom, chromatic split, flash, shake or glitch** - or on every beat
Letters can **bounce** a little on every beat
**3D extruded text** (flat, subtle or deep) with its own colour
**27 new presets** with cleaner colours, and a simpler **Lyrics Studio** with tabs and a colour picker
Faster: lyrics cost far less, even with effects on
**Sit & stay** and **do a trick** on a key (pick them in the controls) - other players see it too
Your pet **joins in when you emote** with its kill celebration
Pets now **show in first person** at their normal spot beside you
**Hide All Pets While Fighting**: every pet steps aside for a few seconds when you hit or get hit
**Draw every heart variant** - poison, wither, frozen, absorption and more - with a pen that keeps the right hue for each, and a **colour picker** in the pixel editor

**Free clips on your graphics card** (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and VA-API on Linux) at 720p with sound - no more laggy recordings, and the fallback lowers its resolution by itself when your PC can't keep up
The **setup guide** now shows for **every new profile** (also when you launch straight onto a server), and you can open it any time in R-Shift > Settings
Every module that some servers don't allow is now marked **Check Server Rules** (Fullbright, Zoom, Free Look, World Map, Waypoints...) - Safe Mode turns them all off

blocks.caption: The Velo Staff cloak now comes in eight colours.

items: The **Velo Staff cloak** comes in **green, yellow, orange, purple, blue, aqua and pink** too
Got Velo in its first two weeks? Link your Discord and you get the **OG role** automatically
Store cloaks in the launcher update themselves when their art changes
**GPU item meshes**, display culling and cheaper name tags: busy spawns with item displays and holograms run much faster
Online players sync with tiny updates instead of the full list every time
The launcher uses less memory in the background
Long black screen and **"resource pack loading failed"** when starting with music playing (Lyrics) - your packs no longer get switched off
Motion Blur, Color Grading and Lyrics effects stopping after a server resource pack (MCC Island and others)
The Controls screen reopening right after closing it (LabyMod)
Sodium crash in the culling pass, the World Map key showing up in another language
World Notes: sharing stuck forever, the "lead me" text never going away, notes you couldn't delete
Aura density only applying in the launcher, flickering HUD on older Intel graphics after Alt+Tab
Party chat cut off in the Friends panel, friends showing "last seen just now" while offline
The crash dialog now names graphics driver crashes instead of an unrelated earlier error
Rounded corners on the module previews, the launcher avatar, and many small things
